messages:
Marta (CSM): quick heads-up — Mira's analytics org just surfaced new internal projects. want to capture signal here and coordinate enablement.
Marta (CSM): they want embeddings for product catalog + realtime summarization for customer transcripts. 3 new teams, unknown traffic profile yet but they said 'much more than pilot'.
Anya (Mira): hi team — yes, confirming: analytics, search, and ops want to onboard. pilot was small (search only) but looks like production rollout next quarter.
Leo (AE): great, congrats. do we know expected concurrency or qps? renewal scheduled in 5 months, would be good to align pricing.
Anya (Mira): rough guess: current pilot ~50 rps, target is 200–300 rps steady + spikes to 1k during business hours. embeddings: batch refresh daily for ~1.2M items.
Marta (CSM): thanks. putting on our radar for expansion + possible Dedicated ask. Raj, can you propose infrastructure + enablement checklist?
Raj (Solutions): yeah. initial recommendation: dedicated GPU pool with autoscale + prefix caching for summaries, separate embedding pipeline with nightly bulk batching. suggest quantized 4bit for embeddings service to save costs.
Raj (Solutions): quick config sketch:
```
service: embeddings
mode: batch
items_per_batch: 4096
quantization: q4_0
autoscale: min:2,max:8
```
Raj (Solutions): also recommend canary rollout for summarization model to monitor latency/regressions.
Devon (SRE): from infra POV we need expected token/sec and typical seq length to size nodes. do they have sample prompts or token counts?
Anya (Mira): summary length ~150 tokens, avg prompt ~60 tokens. embeddings chunking ~256 tokens each.
Devon (SRE): OK that helps. rough capacity calc: at 300 rps with avg 150 tokens -> ~45k tokens/sec. needs X GPUs (we'll calc precisely).
InfraBot: deploy-preview: dedicated-pool/mira-embeddings created (idle) — link: https://console.redwood/dedicated/pools/preview/mira-embeddings
Marta (CSM): action items
- Raj: formal proposal (infra + cost ballpark + rollout plan) — due EOW
- Devon: capacity calc + node sizing — due Tue next week
- Leo: schedule pricing/renewal sync with Anya — put on calendar
- CSM: set up onboarding playbook + enablement docs for 3 teams
Leo (AE): I'll propose 30/60/90 pricing scenarios in the sync.
Anya (Mira): would appreciate a cost estimate asap — procurement needs to budget.
Raj (Solutions): I'll attach an estimate with two options: burst on hosted + fallback to dedicated vs pure dedicated.
Marta (CSM): also capturing renewal risk: if we can't offer predictable latency at scale, there's moderate churn risk. make sure SLOs and fallback paths documented.
Devon (SRE): suggest we include automatic fallback to smaller model variant in region B if capacity constrained.
Raj (Solutions): adding rollout checkpoints: 0% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with evaluation suite (prompt set from Mira).
Marta (CSM): will coordinate prompt set collection from Anya. Anya, can you share ~50 representative queries per team?
Anya (Mira): yes, sending items after internal review by EOD Thu.
Marta (CSM): perfect. I'll also loop in Solutions Eng for an onboarding workshop — propose 60-min technical deep dive + 30-min ops review.
Leo (AE): added a tentative calendar invite for next Wed, will update with agenda.
Devon (SRE): FYI, we might need a temporary rate limit increase on their org for initial ingest — I'll open the request once we have exact numbers.
Marta (CSM): thanks everyone. tagging this as expansion-signal + high priority. will update thread as we get estimates. :raised_hands:
